description.narrative: The project is planned to support Djibouti’s efforts on promoting effective and inclusive governance by enhancing institutional capacities for developing and implementing anti-corruption initiatives and fostering platforms for enhanced civic engagement.

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)
